acceptanceCriteria: The receipt distinguishes independently observed from hook-reported server identity
A forged hook identity cannot produce a complete verdict
body: Found by the V1-2011 lane (PR #1285, head 17e98b009, BBF-V0-019..028). The declared-isolation shared-server profile records server identity as reported by the caller's hook; Corvint does not check it independently. Expected: the receipt either independently observes the server identity (pid/port/binary digest) or labels the identity as hook-reported and unverified. Actual: hook-reported identity flows into the receipt without that label.

holds.reason: Owner decision: independent shared-server identity probe vs hook-reported incompleteness.

title: Falsification: verify shared-server identity independently instead of trusting the caller's hook report
